name: e2e-zh-tw-language-pack
displayName: E2E Traditional Chinese Language Pack (test fixture)
description: Minimal offline stand-in for Microsoft's Traditional Chinese language pack, used only to make VS Code accept `--locale=zh-tw` in E2E tests. Its own translations are empty (VS Code's core UI stays English) — this only needs to exist so `vscode.env.language` resolves to `zh-tw`, which is all GitLens' own l10n catalog selection depends on.
